{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check for sentinel values (e.g., -999.0)
sentinel_values = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Check data types and unique values for severity
severity_counts = trial_df['severity'].value_counts()

missing_values, sentinel_values.shape[0], severity_counts"}
